niche_preference_profile: This user prefers clean, airy, conventional-looking interfaces with strong visual hierarchy, clear labels, and enough content to feel complete. They like warm and approachable tone in onboarding and alerts, but they do not want the screen to feel sparse, unfinished, or overloaded with controls. They tend to favor polished, app-like layouts with balanced spacing, readable sections, and obvious primary actions.

criteria.description: Clear primary heading, strong section emphasis, and an obvious focal point for the main action or content.
A screen that feels complete and informative, with enough content to avoid emptiness, but not so much that it becomes crowded or cluttered.
Fewer visible controls at once, with straightforward toggles, rows, and actions that reduce configuration complexity.
Well-organized grouped sections with separators or cards that make the structure easy to scan and understand.
Warm, reassuring, concise copy and a softer emotional tone rather than stern, alarmist, or overly formal messaging.
A finished, app-like, modern interface that feels refined, readable, and not prototype-like or placeholder-like.
